criteria.name: credential_vault
criteria.description: AES-256-GCM encryption correctly specified; OS keychain integration for master key described; injection mechanism prevents secrets from appearing in logs; rotation procedure defined

criteria.name: scanning_pipeline
criteria.description: All 4 layers (L1-L4) fully specified with latency targets; L3 names a specific local model (e.g., phi-3-mini, tinyllama) with justification; L3 prompt template included

criteria.name: behavioral_chain_state_machine
criteria.description: State machine has at least 3 states with explicit transitions; at least 4 detection patterns defined; false positive mitigation for power users addressed

criteria.name: pii_approval_workflow
criteria.description: Async hold mechanism described; Telegram message template provided; approve/deny/approve-always options defined; timeout and non-response handling specified

criteria.name: credential_redaction
criteria.description: At least 8 regex patterns listed; placeholder format matches __REDACTED_TYPE_SERIAL__; redaction mapping lifecycle explained; double-redaction prevention addressed; placement in pipeline specified
